name: cbio-braf-msk-archer-2024
alternateName: BRAF Fusions - ARCHER Clinical Sequencing Cohort (MSK, Clin Cancer Res 2024)
description: Targeted sequencing of 107 clinical cases via ARCHER to characterize the structure and impact of BRAF fusions on clinical course in a tumor-agnostic approach. This study is part of a broader analysis and is complemented by a parallel study using MSK-IMPACT sequencing (see related MSK-IMPACT study).

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
